defs.rule:
PHD-MAIN-STAGE2-v1 4.0: region file v3 and the evaluation rows of 'B0 저자 15장' (A15, LoD2) with the stage-1 chain (jointbuildgs:dev,
CPU; run_cpu2.sh). The chain is stage 1's own code, called unchanged; only the folders it reads are pointed at this condition:
  1. z_MVS at the GT points (regions_v3.mvs_read's rule: 0.1 m cell medians of the geometric depth, >= 3 points, the fix's GT index
     lists) from the A15 MVS (prep mvs/B0_A15, the 13 training views)                 -> <root>/regions_v3/mvs_at_gt_B0_b10.npz
  2. agreement codes (stage-0 regions_v1.py rule) from the A15 box run (a15/box: B0's fixed tolerance and registration, the B0 box's
     patches) and the v3 labels of the B0 box (stage 1 v3/box_gt; the patches are the same, so are the labels) -> <root>/v3/regions
  3. regions_v3.chain (codes 11-14, the v2 split by z_MVS - z_GT), gt_suspect (regions_v3.suspect with the ULS attributes of the
     needed points), premise violation / band (metrics_v3.premise.split, k = 1 for LoD2) -> <root>/regions_v3/regions_ext_v3_B0_b10_LoD2.npz
  4. the rows (defs_s1.rows_of) with the B0 box's GT classes (stage 1 defs/B0_b10/gt_classes.npz) -> S2/defs/B0a15/rows_LoD2.npz; the
     GT- and prior-only files of defs/B0_b10 are linked (gt_classes, prior_LoD2, top_raster, bsurf); gate sample counts.
<root> = S2/a15/root (its v3/box_gt links the stage-1 labels). The stage-1 module constant OUT is pointed at <root> while the chain
runs (it reads only the files listed above there).
  python a15_defs.py run        the A15 files
  python a15_defs.py check      the same code path on the stage-1 B0 inputs (box run, box MVS) must reproduce the stage-1 region file
                                regions_ext_v3_B0_b10_LoD2.npz and rows_LoD2.npz exactly -> S2/a15/check_b0.json
